notes:
Summary: mid-market product-analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood after 3-week hosted API pilot. Primary goal: move to Dedicated for predictable latency and unit cost once sizing is validated.

Pilot findings (hosted API):
- Typical traffic profile: product assistant + support chat + on-demand reranking for search. Mix approx: 45% short chat/help (avg 120 tokens), 35% embeddings/search requests (avg 80 tokens), 15% mid-length summarization (avg 420 tokens), 5% long analysis (>2000 tokens).
- Observed peaks: 28 QPS sustained peak during feature launch simulation; 40 concurrent open sessions at peak. Burst windows ~2-3 minutes with 60 QPS observed in replay tests.
- Latency: using hosted_api with model "meta-llama-2-13b" variant, measured P50=85ms token latency, P95=340ms token latency for chat completions under hosted trial constraints. User-facing 99th perc latency target = 200ms for typical chat flows (strict).
- Token economics: average request tokens ~420 (prompt+completion). Avg tokens per day during trial ~3.2M, estimated steady-state at 15M tokens/month for initial rollout. Cost sensitivity: mid (wants to reduce 30-40% unit cost vs hosted).
- Reliability: saw 2 brief throttles during high concurrency test (rate-limit config on hosted plan) -> motivated Dedicated interest.

Dedicated sizing ask / POC goals:
- Customer expects Dedicated to handle sustained 80 QPS with headroom for bursts to 150 QPS for 10-minute windows. Target sustained concurrency target = 120 slots.
- Token mix assumptions for sizing: 50% short (<200 tokens), 40% medium (200-800), 10% long (>800 up to 4k). Use these for KV/prefix cache config to reduce compute.
- Requested SE guidance on node count: starting proposal = 4x A100-equivalent nodes with autoscaling to +2 nodes on burst; evaluate quantized model variant for 2x throughput improvement on medium tokens.
- Networking / security: must support VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, audit logging retention 1 year, SSO via SAML (Okta).

POC timeline / milestones:
- Week 0: finalize SOW and IP/NDA (legal) -> deliver pricing.
- Week 1-2: Dedicated staging deploy with VPC peering; replay hosted trial logs to validate throughput.
- Week 3: Stress test (QPS ramp to 150, concurrency soak); latency SLO verification (P95 < 200ms for chat).
- Week 4: Cost runbook + autoscaling policy handoff; sign-off from product + infra.

Quotes & subjective notes:
- Product lead (Kayla): "We need predictable tail latency more than headline throughput — customers notice spikes immediately."
- CTO (Raj): "If Dedicated gets us 30% unit cost reduction and stable 99th percentile, procurement will greenlight."

Open questions for Redwood:
- Exact throughput per node for chosen model variant under expected token mix (request per second per A100-equivalent).
- Recommendations on batching window to meet 200ms P95 constraint while maximizing cost efficiency.
- Clear pricing for committed capacity + overage during launch month.

Next step (AE/SE): deliver a Dedicated sizing spreadsheet (attached) with three scenarios (conservative / expected / optimistic) and a draft pricing term sheet. Follow up meeting scheduled to review sizing on 2026-03-15.
